#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

int main() {
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);
    while (line.empty()) {
        std::getline(std::cin, line);
    }
    std::string s;
    std::istringstream iss(line);
    iss >> s;
    
    int ans = 0;
    bool even = false;
    char prev = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (i == 0 || c != prev) {
            if (i > 0 && even) {
                ans++;
            }
            even = false;
            prev = c;
        } else {
            even = !even;
        }
    }
    if (even) {
        ans++;
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
